name: mundophpbb/workspace
description: Collaborative IDE for building phpBB extensions in the browser: shared projects, versions, reviews and tasks, plus an optional pre-validation with the official phpBB EPV to speed up the extension review. Includes a visual phpBB feature generator, cross-project version comparison, and a static dependency map, an ACL permission simulator, a read-only compatibility laboratory and external phpBB testing workflow generator. Adds project-wide recovery checkpoints with guarded restoration. Adds guarded global source search and preview-based refactoring. Adds checkpoint-based, previewable release notes generation for CHANGELOG.md. Includes a read-only, bounded security audit with confidence-ranked findings and source navigation. Adds a read-only upgrade assistant for comparing phpBB extension releases and highlighting migration, ACL and compatibility risks. Includes a preview-based PHPUnit test scaffold generator for services, controllers and ACL declarations with guarded writes and clearly incomplete behavior tests. Adds a read-only quality dashboard that aggregates static findings, test and maintenance evidence, and compares authorized project versions without inventing coverage or pass rates. Includes a sandboxed, read-only visual preview of phpBB HTML/Twig templates with sample data and optional CSS; no template or script execution. Adds previewable automatic bilingual documentation generated from saved extension metadata and code structure, with optional guarded README updates. Adds optional, per-project, public GitHub repository linking and read-only commit checks, with manual preview-confirmed imports and no credential storage. Adds read-only public GitHub Actions results and a copyable phpBB test workflow preview, without tokens or automatic publication. Adds read-only public GitHub Releases and release-to-saved-project comparisons, without publishing or installing code. Release comparisons can be filtered and exported as a bounded, formula-safe CSV report, with a bounded read-only UTF-8 line diff for each changed file. Adds a read-only recent GitHub commit history, changed-file inspection and a pinned-commit comparison with saved project files. Adds per-project release records with preserved checkpoint snapshots, recorded package names and notes, and a preview-gated recovery handoff; does not archive actual distribution ZIPs. Adds a read-only, access-controlled project and releases portfolio, with local search and missing-record filters. Adds six-month access-controlled developer statistics for projects, files, tasks, releases and recorded activities, with explicit sample limits. Adds an evidence-based, read-only maintenance overview for authorized projects using persisted tasks, locks and release dates; EPV and CI statuses are explicitly not inferred. Adds administrator-only ACP-registered local environment diagnostics for PHP modules, GitHub prerequisites and EPV installation, without network requests or sensitive path disclosure. Adds contextual, localized causes, affected features and manual remediation guidance to ACP diagnostics without automated changes. Adds opt-in, per-project manual restore-point integrity auditing, age warnings and comparison against saved files, without automatic changes or falsely equating database snapshots with external backups. Adds per-project portable SHA-256 manifest ZIP export and read-only uploaded ZIP verification with change preview, without automatic restoration. Adds selective portable ZIP recovery with checksum revalidation, explicit confirmation, revision-bound previews and atomic pre-restore checkpoints. Adds preview-confirmed, file-only ZIP migration into a new private project on another installation, without reusing source project IDs. Adds preview-only Composer manifest cleanup for identical duplicate requirements, staged in the editor with explicit confirmation and normal guarded save. Adds declaration-only Composer dependency warnings to the PHP compatibility lab without installing or resolving dependencies. Adds a conservative PHP-version compatibility matrix and bounded Composer dependency inventory to the existing static test laboratory; never claims actual phpBB compatibility without runtime tests.
